title: the venv carries the dev extra
intention: Every box's ~/.cairn/venv carries pyproject's dev extra. Bootstrap's verify names a venv without it as a finding with its repair, and its apply installs the editable checkout with [dev].
why: Measured 2026-11-12: on akienasus, ~/.cairn/venv had no pytest. akienasus_cc_0 installed the dev extra (pytest, wtree, starlette) by hand. A box that cannot import pytest cannot run `cairn test`, so it proves nothing.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: proofs must be runnable on every box to measure anything. Law 4: the akienasus hand install becomes the floor's physics.
how: In bootstrap.sh: a dev-extra probe after the psycopg2 probe reads the extra's names from pyproject.toml; apply installs '<repo>[dev]'; the stamp gains 'extras=dev'. Proved in scratch CAIRN_VENVs driven through _sh, with a recording stub interpreter for the apply tooth.

clauses.claim: cairn_bootstrap_apply over a scratch CAIRN_VENV whose python is a recording stub invokes pip install --editable on '<repo>[dev]'
a venv with the editable install but missing a dev-extra module fails cairn_bootstrap_verify, with a finding that names the dev extra and its repair
a stamp written without 'extras=dev' does not match _cairn_stamp_want

decisions.text: D1: in cairn_bootstrap_verify, right after the psycopg2 probe, the venv's python reads [project.optional-dependencies].dev from pyproject.toml with tomllib, strips version specifiers, and imports each name. On any failure it appends 'DEV EXTRA MISSING ... Repair: $venv/bin/pip install -e "$CAIRN_REPO_ROOT[dev]"' and returns 1. Apply's editable install becomes --editable "$CAIRN_REPO_ROOT[dev]", and the three 'Repair:' strings naming pip install -e follow suit. _cairn_stamp_want adds the literal 'extras=dev'.

D2: the proof drives bootstrap.sh through a scratch CAIRN_VENV, one tooth per clause (PROVES 1-3). The apply tooth uses a stub python that records its argv and answers pip --version, so nothing reaches the network.

measured.saw: akienasus ~/.cairn/venv had no pytest; the dev extra was installed by hand
measured.how: akienasus_cc_0's report, relayed by the orchestrator

measured.saw: bootstrap.sh line 282 runs pip install --editable on the repo with no extra
